title: Schmoo Radio Show (Trailer)
description: This playful stop-motion piece was created for The Schmoo Show, which is a radio show on Ethiopian Broadcasting Corporation Radio (EBC Radio). This is their first ever trailer for the show. It was featured on multiple social media platforms (such as Sheger Gebeta Telegram Page).
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Voiceover: Yonatan Zenebe, Nafkot Gebeyehu
Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: 427 Anthem (Official Music Video)
description: 427 Anthem was the first ever anthem for the famous Beza Youth event, FNF (Friday Night Fire). The theme of the event was #IamFindingMe. This give us the idea of revealing identities of our silhouette talents in the video. And that’s what we ended up doing for this final piece.
credits: Production: Beza Youth, Friday Night Fire (FNF)
Creative Direction: Addismiraph Abebe, Ammanuel A. Wake
Music: ISAAC
Vocals: Shalom Adugna, T(from Cross Concept)
Camera: @gift_habeshaw
Editing: Ammanuel A. Wake
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: Smart-face and Conveyer Belt
description: WFP (Ethiopia Office), was about to introduce a new system to their loading, unloading and delivering pipeline. It involved, smart-face, a realtime communications USSD implementation, and the introduction of the conveyer belt. FBF was tasked with understanding the concept and delivering a short yet comprehensive video that can later be viewed to easily demonstrate the new process.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu Voiceover: Ebba T.
Music: Ermias Molla
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: One Block Campaign
description: Beza International Ministries requested a video for a campaign that explained how a contribution of blocks (price of a block) can collectively bring about the required amount of budget to build their new building, Africa Worship Center. FBF was tasked with understanding the concept and creating the infographic piece. The video was then shown at the church for people to understand the concept and then contribute their blocks.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Script: Ammanuel A. Wake, Bersabe
Voiceover: Mekonnen Brook
Design & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: Tsilat – Opening Titles
description: This Opening Sequence was created for the new bible teaching series named Tsilat (Tablets of Moses). The sequence tries to comprise different elements of representations of major bible events leading up to the name/objects of the show.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu
Design & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu

title: Kibir Be’Aryam (Official Lyric Video)
description: This was a Christmas lyric video project. It involved creating all the still frames with different Christmas related characters followed with animating the scene in 2.5D along with the custom typography created for the project.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu Music: Endalkachew Hawaz
Music: Endalkachew Hawaz
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu
Typeface Design: Fitsum Admasu

title: RedeeMedia – Training on Media Missions and Creativity in Ministry
description: RedeeMedia approached us for their promo video of a training event they’d organized. The approach of the trendy flat design on this video was timely as the audience was about to take training on Media Missions and Creativity in Ministry. The video was completed in a span of one and a half weeks.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: Addis Sew Negn
description: This creative piece was done after a brief with RedeeMedia. The notion of labels that create a mess in our heads was depicted with the different combinations of words. The labels disappear leaving the main idea that was meant to get across to the audience of the video which was “Addis Sew Negn” (I am a New Creation) bring the video to its end.
credits: Creative Direction: Genaye Eshetu, Ammanuel A. Wake
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: AHIF 2019 – Highlights Video
client: Africa Hotel Investment Forum, Bench Events, Flawless Events
description: This highlight video was created for an event that was held in October 2019, at the Sheraton Addis Hotel, Addis Ababa. The event was held in various hotels around Addis in the time span of three days.
credits: Creative Direction: Muhammed Ahmed, Ammanuel A. Wake
Camera: Elias Berhanu, Andualem Aseffa, Mikiyas Girmachew, Simon Seyfu
Editing: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu

title: Now Is The Time – A Short Film
description: As Beza International’s Africa Arise annual conference was celebrating its 10th year anniversary with a theme of “Now Is The Time”, FBF was tasked with making a short-film to open the conference. The 2-minute short-film was mostly made on iPhone.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake Script: Jesse Millar
Voice Over: George A. Asamani
Camera: Abel Tadesse, Ammanuel A. Wake

title: Tana Forum 2019 – Highlights Video
description: This was the highlights video of the 2019 Annual Tana Forum Conference that was held in Bahir-Dar. This video was used to recap all the important happenings of the conference as well as promote the upcoming one.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Camera: Elias Berhanu, Mikias Girmachew, Simon Seyfu
Motion Graphics: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: I Am An African – 7th Edition of The Youth Mag
description: The Youth Mag, a magazine made by youths for youths, was making its seventh issue an online version. This video was made to promote youths around the African continent to contribute their thoughts on the theme “Pan- Africanism”.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Voiceover: Betsega Getachew
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: IFRC – Practice Guide for Migrant Health Workers
description: This short animation was made to explain how the work of Migrant Health Workers could have a huge impact on migrants and how they should adopt a new practice guide made by the International Federation of Red Cross (IFRC). The story revolves around one migrant family who faces a common issue when migrating.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Voiceover: Gebeya Media Productions
Storyboard: Gebeya Media Productions
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake, Gebeya Media Productions
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

title: We Love Walking Together – Tsi-Mirrors
description: Tsi-Mirrors is a mentorship program designed for young women in various walks of life. This video was produced to explain the core idea of the project and was featured on the launching of the program at Sapphire Addis Hotel.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake Voiceover: Tsion Diriba

title: Ignite Africa Challenge

title: Balenjeraye Animation Series
description: This collage of videos was produced in collaboration with our partner agency, Firma Media and Communications. The videos explore how the different parts of our bodies could be used to love our neighbors and create harmony in our communities.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake, Fitsum Admasu

title: Marriage Laws In Africa
description: As one of their priority for 2019, UN Women and Plan International along with the African Union had prepared a compendium on Marriage Laws in Africa that was collected from 55 African Union Member States. As it was over 50 pages long, UN Women tasked us with presenting the important parts of the compendium in a short animation video. This video was then produced to be presented at their unveiling event.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Script: Ammanuel A. Wake, Yordanos Wolde Voiceover: Yordanos Wolde
Music: ISAAC
Design: Ammanuel A. Wake
Motion Graphics & Animation: Ammanuel A. Wake

description: This lyric video was made for the second anthem of Beza Youth’s Friday Night Fire (FNF). It was only suiting to use emojis and animojis as it describes the playful yet expressive words that were being said in the lyrics.

title: Startup Ethiopia – Highlights Video
description: Startup Ethiopia was the first-ever conference in Ethiopia that was designed to help startups win funds and also network with potential angels. During this first-of-its-kind event, FBF was tasked with live-streaming the event as well as edit a short highlights video.
credits: Creative Direction: Ammanuel A. Wake
Camera: Elias Berhanu, Andualem Aseffa, Simon Seyfu

title: Mindset, A COVID-19 Special Show – Trailer
description: Mindset Consult, a renown consultancy and training firm in Ethiopia was broadcasting a special show on COVID-19 to create awareness. FBF was responsible to direct and edit the 3 month long show on Fana TV. This was the trailer we prepared for it.

title: 5th Annual Private Equity on East Africa – Highlights Video
description: Held at the Sheraton Hotel in June of 2019, the 5th Annual Private Equity on East Africa is a conference hosted by the East Africa Venture Capital Association and organized by Flawless Events. FBF was there to live-stream and record the event. The final outcome was this 7 minute highlights video that they used for their 6th Annual Conference.
